description: This source file defines themed styling for a Flutter app using Material 3. It includes a function to build a custom theme, a reusable decoration, and a subtle gradient, all contributing to the app's visual design.

methods.name: buildOceanProfessionalTheme

methods.name: oceanSoftCardDecoration
